summary: Euroseas Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release about two-year charter contract extensions for its 1,800 teu feeder containerships M/V Stephania K and M/V Pepi Star at a gross daily rate of $25,500. The charters run 24-26 months, starting July and August 2026, expected to generate ~$27 million EBITDA. This is an ordinary course business contract extension, not a special situation. No category applies.
